Method p()

Usage

distribution.continuous.normal.class$p(q, lower.tail = TRUE, log.p = FALSE)

Arguments

q

vector of quantiles.

logical; if TRUE (default), probabilities are \(P[ X \leq x ]\), otherwise, \(P[X>x]\).
